aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and travelling catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and travelling catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a specific date or time in the future before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break sales data down by time period, item and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one separately.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When handing out a buzzer, give the order a buzzer number so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers showing order numbers and when the orders are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck is visible on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your website. Each date leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.

featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — and all of them show the same current orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login details with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused so customers cannot place orders you will not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you can keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a last ordering time for items that must be ordered in good time.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that are not shown on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already publish on Facebook. You only need to review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers a text message when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it immediately turns grey for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it goes down as orders come in, until the item automatically becomes sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone so you do not need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand is spread across your whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders on the spot at the truck, paid on your card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Auto-replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wireless internet and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was created exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused automatically so customers cannot place orders you will not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Created for food truck businesses, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you drive to your pitch or stand at the grill, your WhatsApp gets answers based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answers while you drive to your pitch or stand at the grill. Then Messenger and Instagram.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and in under 60 seconds we will turn it into a working ordering page you can try out. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Take a look, then decide.
